data.title: 萝丝 · 暴雨走廊中的戒指托付
data.description: 水雾弥漫的石柱长廊外大雨倾盆。身着白金骑士礼服的萝丝紧紧握住少年的双手，琥珀色泪眼闪耀着破釜沉舟的决绝，将珍贵的戒指贴在胸口。
data.location: covered gothic academy stone arcade during a torrential thunderstorm
data.action: holding Cid hands tightly against her chest, gazing with tear-glistening amber eyes full of tragic romantic devotion, offering ancestral ring
data.lighting: dramatic overcast rainy skylight reflecting in puddle water on flagstone floor
data.mood: tragic noble romance, desperate earnest devotion, sacrificial chivalry
data.promptProse: In a rainswept stone corridor, blonde knight princess Rose holds hands against her chest with tearful amber eyes.
data.animaCaption: Entrusting the ring and her devoted heart with trembling hands amidst the torrential rain.
